design_description: A bold Chicos Tóxicos away kit featuring an off-white base with chaotic, cracked textures in green, purple and pale blue. A large distressed skull illustration dominates the lower front, surrounded by fractured, web-like graphics that extend across the sleeves and back. The back features oversized green brushstroke numbering, a matching player name and a purple biohazard symbol near the hem. Subtle green collar and cuff trim, alongside matching patterned shorts, complete the rebellious, toxic-inspired aesthetic.
